Eric Burlison discusses election law, MKULTRA accountability, and podcast release in new tweets
Rep. Eric Burlison, U.S. Congressman representing Missouri’s 7th district since 2023, shared a series of posts on June 30, 2026, addressing topics ranging from election law to historical government accountability and podcast promotion.
In a tweet posted at 1:44 a.m., Burlison announced an upcoming podcast episode: "Fresh Freedom Episode 73 featuring @UAPGERB @ProfAviLoeb @haroldputhoff drops Tuesday morning."
Later that day, at 2:03 p.m., Burlison referenced his involvement in legal proceedings related to election laws, stating, "I led an amicus brief in this case because Election Day should mean Election Day. Justice Alito's dissent explains why that principle still matters."
At 3:50 p.m., Burlison raised questions about the legacy of the CIA's MKULTRA program with another post, "If Americans were secretly drugged and experimented on through the CIA's MKULTRA program, was anyone ever held accountable? The witness: 'No.'"
Burlison, who succeeded Billy Long in Congress after serving in both chambers of the Missouri legislature and graduating from Missouri State University, has focused on issues including electoral integrity and government transparency throughout his political career. Born in Springfield in 1976 and currently residing in Ozark, he continues to engage constituents on national policy debates via social media.
